headline: Zul'Gurub in 40:48, no wipes, Alanakos top on six bosses

mvp.headline: the most damage on six of nine bosses
why: First on Venoxis, Mar'li, Thekal, Arlokk, Jin'do and Hakkar, second on Mandokir and Wushoolay

also.text: the most healing on seven bosses
the most damage on Jeklik and Mandokir, and tanked Arlokk to a 95

overview: Nine kills on nine pulls in 40:48, against a usual 52:30, with 20 raiders. Five boss deaths: Macharius and Wrenn to Wushoolay at 0:29 and 0:30, Palastino to Zealot Zath and Macharius again on Thekal (Paidwithbeer brought him back), and Wellan to Hakkar at 1:41, just before the kill.
Five trash deaths, two of them around the 21 minute mark to a Mad Voidwalker and a Mad Servant.

wentWell.text: Hakkar in 1:43 (median 2:12), Corrupted Blood at about the usual rate.
Thekal's one Great Heal kicked, and Paidwithbeer's Rebirth on Macharius after he died at 0:51.
Jeklik in 0:40, two seconds off the guild best.

notes.text: 0:40 (median 0:52), no deaths. Mercîless top, Wizness parse 96.
0:39 (median 0:48), no deaths. The Holy Wrath chain hit 12 raiders, a little over the usual.
1:11, no deaths. Four Gazes, no Guillotines.
Wushoolay in 0:32. He killed Macharius, tanking, at 0:29 and Wrenn a second later. Lightning Cloud did over half the damage taken.
1:27. Zealot Zath's Sweeping Strikes killed Palastino at 0:42 and Thekal killed Macharius at 0:51; Paidwithbeer's Rebirth brought him back.
0:28, no deaths. Mercîless tanked her to a 95.
0:41, no deaths, the Hex dispelled by Daki.
1:43. Wellan, tanking, died to Hakkar at 1:41. Macharius was mind-controlled four times.
